description: This script sets up a Node.js environment by installing or uninstalling a specific version of Node.js tailored for supported architectures. It detects system architecture, defines environment variables for Node.js installation paths, verifies the checksum of the downloaded binaries, and manages installation and cleanup processes.

methods.name: uninstall_nodejs
methods.description: Removes the Node.js installation directory by deleting the NODE_ROOT folder.

methods.name: install_nodejs
methods.description: Downloads, verifies, and extracts the specified Node.js version to set up the environment.
